title: 第154章 一叶宗的内忧外患第153章 说说吧你们宗门是怎么回事
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
第一卷第154章一叶宗的内忧外患
在一叶宗几个长老的你一言我一语中，洛还真逐渐还原了一叶宗没落的真相。
一叶宗原本是中洲一个非常厉害的大宗门派。
但是十年前，中洲发生了一场鬼潮大灾难，因为鬼潮的核心源头距离一叶宗比较近，所有中洲的仙盟将这场灾难分配给了一叶宗。
一叶宗派出了大量的精锐弟子，甚至就连一宗之主也亲自出动，进行了抵御。
事情最终成功解决了。
鬼潮结束。
宗主回来了。
只是精锐弟子们全部没了。
宗主回来的时候，不论是精神面貌还是神态，都非常不好。
诸位长老只当自家宗主是因为剿鬼的缘故，精神状态不好。
可没想到过了不到十天，宗主就不告而别，消失不见了。
整个宗门一下子乱了阵脚。
而宗主失踪，精锐弟子全部折损这个事情，没能瞒得下去，很快就让中洲其他的宗门知道了。
一叶宗的宗门选址很好，拥有一条属于自己宗门的内置大型灵脉，灵脉之下，还有数不清的灵石资源。
因此，一叶宗虽然尚没有渡劫期修士坐镇，却依旧稳稳跻身中洲宗门前十的修真宗门。
这样的一个宗门，自然会引得许多其他的宗门垂涎，想要纳为己有。
于是，以前一直和一叶宗针锋相对的混元宗便开始了行动。
他们不止各种煽风点火，让其他宗门来挖一叶宗的弟子，还三番五次地悄悄来一叶宗的宗门附近踩点，目的就是吞并掉一叶宗，让它成为他们混元宗的一部分。
但幸好，一叶宗以前的老祖宗，也出过大能前辈。

那是一个主修阵法的大能修士。
他在飞升之前，想到了自家宗门的特殊与诱人，所以设置了一个能将整个宗门藏起来的仙级阵法，用以保护自家宗门。
但是宗门被封起来之后，宗门内部的内置灵脉也会被封住，同时，只能进人不能出人。
除此之外，他还留有另一个后招——一叶宗的每一任宗主，都会传承一项秘法，接引九霄天雷增强实力，来守护宗门。
此秘法一生只能使用一次，但是每一次使用，都能发挥出仙人级别的水准，本质上是沟通了仙界老祖的力量，来保护自家宗门。
只是宗主失踪，这层保险就断了。
所以，他们只剩下最后这一条藏起整个宗门的路可以走了。
所有人都不知道宗主是死是活，他们将宗门藏起来之后，只有宗主令这个钥匙，才能将他们释放出来。
可藏起宗门，没有灵力滋养，所有人的修为就会停滞。
这对任何一个修士而言，都是一场得不偿失的选择。
所以在启动藏宗阵法之前，一叶宗的长老们，将这次的危机告知了宗门所有弟子。
然后，直接果断地遣散了一叶宗的弟子们。
一代宗门，就此没落。
原本宗门还有六个长老来着。
只是在一叶宗闭宗的这十年时间里，寿元耗尽的还有两位。
洛大海寿元都还好。
只是没有灵力滋养，他的心肺在以前与混元宗对战的时候，本就落下了隐疾。
现在更是越来越差，整个人快要不行了。
这也是为什么，他们在接收到来自宗主令传音的那一刻，为什么那么激动的原因。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 154 The Internal and External Troubles of Yiye Sect
In the words of Yiye Zong's elders, Luo Huanzhen gradually restored the truth of Yiye Zong's decline.
The Yiye Sect was originally a very powerful sect in Central Continent.
But ten years ago, a catastrophic ghost tide occurred in Central Continent. Because the core source of the ghost tide was relatively close to the One Leaf Sect, all the Immortal Alliances in Central Continent assigned this disaster to the One Leaf Sect.
The Yiye Sect sent a large number of elite disciples, and even the leader of the Yiye Sect personally went out to resist.
Things eventually worked out successfully.
The ghost tide is over.
The sect leader is back.
It’s just that all the elite disciples are gone.
When the sect leader came back, both his mental outlook and demeanor were in very bad shape.
The elders only thought that their own sect leader was in a bad mental state because of the ghost hunt.
Unexpectedly, less than ten days later, the sect leader left without saying goodbye and disappeared.
The entire sect was suddenly in chaos.
As for the fact that the sect leader was missing and all the elite disciples were lost, they could not keep it a secret and soon let other sects in Central Continent know about it.
The Yiye Sect's sect has a very good location. It has a large built-in spiritual vein belonging to its own sect. Under the spiritual vein, there are countless spiritual stone resources.
Therefore, although Yiye Sect does not yet have any cultivators in the Tribulation Stage, it is still firmly among the top ten cultivation sects in Central Continent.
Such a sect will naturally attract many other sects to covet it and want to take it as their own.
As a result, the Hunyuan Sect, which had been in tit-for-tat confrontation with the Yiye Sect before, began to take action.
They not only fanned the flames and asked other sects to poach Yiye Sect's disciples, but also quietly came to visit Yiye Sect's sect again and again, with the purpose of annexing Yiye Sect and making it a part of their Hunyuan Sect.
But fortunately, the ancestors of Yiye Sect also produced powerful seniors.
That was a powerful monk who majored in formations.
Before he ascended, he thought of the specialness and attractiveness of his sect, so he set up a fairy-level formation that could hide the entire sect to protect his sect.
But after the sect is sealed, the built-in spiritual veins inside the sect will also be sealed. At the same time, people can only enter but not leave.
In addition, he also has another trick left - every sect leader of Yiye Sect will inherit a secret method to attract the Nine Heavens Thunder to increase his strength and protect the sect.
This secret method can only be used once in a lifetime, but every time it is used, it can perform at the level of an immortal. In essence, it communicates with the power of the ancestors of the immortal world to protect one's own sect.
But if the sect leader disappears, this layer of insurance is broken.
Therefore, they only have the last way to hide the entire sect.
No one knows whether the sect master is dead or alive. After they hide the sect, only the key of the sect master's order can release them.
But if the sect is hidden and without spiritual nourishment, everyone's cultivation will stagnate.
For any monk, this is a choice that pays off.
Therefore, before activating the Tibetan Sect formation, the elders of Yiye Sect informed all the disciples of the sect about the crisis.
Then, he directly and decisively dismissed the disciples of Yiye Sect.
A generation of sects fell into decline.
Originally, there were six elders in the sect.
However, in the ten years since Yiye Sect was closed, there were still two people who had exhausted their longevity.
Luo Dahai and his longevity are all fine.
But without spiritual nourishment, his heart and lungs had suffered from hidden diseases during the previous battle with the Hunyuan Sect.
Now it is getting worse and worse, and I am almost dying.
This is why they were so excited the moment they received the message from the sect leader.
